text:
haley.docs: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a small PR series to consolidate parse examples in the function/tool-calling + structured-output docs. Goal: one canonical set of JSON schema examples, a short guardrails section, and matching SDK snippets. Also fixing a couple stale links under parsing patterns. Will open the first PR in ~1hr.
samir.eng: Nice. Can you enumerate which SDK snippets need edits? I can update Python + TS.
haley.docs: Plan so far:
- Replace 3 ad-hoc examples with two canonical examples: `invoice` and `user_intent`
- Add explicit guardrail section showing schema + fallback strategy
- Update SDK snippets to the new tool-calling/structured-output envelope
- Fix 2 broken links in parsing patterns (anchors changed during last reorg)

anna-devex: I can take SDK snippets. Do we want to switch examples to the `structured_output` param shape we discussed last sprint? Example I had in mind:
```json
{"tool_call": {"name": "get_invoice", "arguments": {"invoice_id": "INV-123"}}, "structured_output": {"schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"amount": {"type": "number"}}}}}
```

mike-rls: Please add a short 'consumer test' section — a tiny snippet showing how to validate the model output against the schema and fallback to text parsing. Saves future churn.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523 by haley.docs

samir.eng: Left a couple inline comments on the PR: schema example 2 is missing the required `amount` property in sample output. Also we should keep a compact envelope example for low-bandwidth clients.

haley.docs: Good catch — will patch. Assigning reviewers: @anna-devex and @samir.eng. Target merge by EOD Friday if all green.

anna-devex: :thumbsup: I'll push updated TS + Python snippets in a follow-up commit (using the new param shape).

haley.docs: Link fixes: replace `/old-path/parse` -> `/docs/parsing/structured-output` and update anchors that jumped. Also adding a short "gotchas" note about nullable arrays and union types.
samir.eng: I can run the sample prompts through the parser harness and paste the raw outputs here so we can add realistic examples if the parser normalizes differently.

haley.docs: Yes please — if outputs deviate, add a short "observed vs expected" note. Also adding a CLI lint example for reviewers: `make docs-lint && ./tools/verify-snippets --path docs/structured-output`

mike-rls: I'll run the canary deploy for the docs site after merge and watch the snippet render differences.

haley.docs: Thanks all — will push fixes in the next hour and ping again when PR has updates.
